parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member account of Cloud Firewall.

parameters.name: NetworkInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **cen\_firewall**

- **cen\_tr\_firewall**

- **ec\_firewall**

parameters.name: TransitRouterId
parameters.description: The ID of the transit router instance.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC instance.
